title: The Sovereignty of God
definition: The sovereignty of God means that God rules over all creation with absolute authority, wisdom, and power.
summary: God reigns over creation, history, nations, suffering, salvation, and the final outcome of all things.
christFocus: Jesus reigns as King of kings and Lord of lords. Nothing in history, creation, or redemption lies outside His authority.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content: God reigns over creation, history, nations, suffering, salvation, and the final outcome of all things.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content: This doctrine matters because it helps believers know God rightly, trust Him more deeply, and follow Christ with clarity instead of confusion.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Receive this truth with humility, bring it into prayer, compare it with Scripture, and let it shape your worship, obedience, witness, and daily walk with Christ.
